mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credential_handles (id, organization_id, name, provider, handle, metadata, secret_ciphertext, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{handle}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM credential_handles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model_profiles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_profiles (id, organization_id, name, provider, model, credential_handle_id, configuration, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{credentialHandleId}, #{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE model_profiles SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), provider = COALESCE(#{provider}, provider), model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), credential_handle_id = CASE WHEN #{credentialHandleId} IS NOT NULL OR #{status} IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(#{credentialHandleId}, credential_handle_id) ELSE credential_handle_id END, configuration = COALESCE(#{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, configuration), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM model_profiles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM credential_handles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT id::text AS id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload, occurred_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM audit_events WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{action}::text IS NULL OR action = #{action}) AND (#{resourceType}::text IS NULL OR resource_type = #{resourceType}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_events (organization_id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{actorUserId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler})
